description: record has zero applied lights entries and so no lawful display, for a vessel with fact:position = position:moored
note: facts.json derives the position enum from Rule 3(i) ("not at anchor, not made fast to the shore, not aground"), so position:moored is the shore-fast case, for which COLREGS prescribes no lights. Correct gap, needs an expected-empty carve-out rather than a fix. Open question: SignalK's `moored` conflates shore-fast with a mooring buoy, which is arguably "at anchor" -- a decoding-layer ambiguity, not an applicability-data one.
